title: Leadership Doesn't Wait for a Title
assessmentMethod: Private reflective journal entry, not scored

body.en: Some of the most effective climate action in Ghana right now is being led by young people with no official position at all — a WhatsApp group organising a neighbourhood cleanup, a student pushing their school to fix a drainage problem, a small group crowdfunding trees for a bare hillside. None of them waited for permission or a title to start. Is there a climate-related problem in your own school, workplace, or community that you'd be willing to be the first person to act on, even in a small way?
